issue_context.title: [BUG] Module not found (component testing)
issue_context.body:
Reopening  #17503; please read last comment there.
## Playwright:
1.27.1
## System:
 - OS: Windows 10 10.0.19044
 - Memory: 16.57 GB / 31.67 GB
## Binaries:
 - Node: 16.15.0 - C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.EXE
 - Yarn: 1.22.4 - C:\Program Files (x86)\Yarn\bin\yarn.CMD
 - npm: 8.5.5 - C:\Program Files\nodejs\npm.CMD
## Languages:
 - Bash: 5.1.16 - C:\WINDOWS\system32\bash.EXE
## Description
I have this project structure:
```
project_root
    be
    fe
        node_modules
        src
            layouts
            Header.tsx
            ...
        playwright
            index.html
            index.ts
        playwright-ct-test
            layouts
                Header.test.tsx
```

In `playwright-ct.config.ts` `testDir` is set to `./playwright-ct-test`. When I run `npx run test-ct` I get (this is the complete output, unlike in the first issue)
```
PS > npm run test-ct-pw

> farmlab-web-fe@0.1.0 test-ct-pw
> playwright test -c playwright-ct.config.ts

Running 0 tests using 0 workers
Error: Cannot find module 'geojson'
Require stack:
- <project_root>\fe\src\measurement\types.ts
- <project_root>\fe\src\user\types.ts
- <project_root>\fe\src\user\userReducer.ts
- <project_root>\fe\src\rootReducers.ts
- <project_root>\fe\src\configureStore.ts
- <project_root>\fe\playwright-ct-test\layouts\Header.test.tsx
- <project_root>\fe\node_modules\@playwright\test\lib\loader.js
- <project_root>\fe\node_modules\@playwright\test\lib\runner.js
- <project_root>\fe\node_modules\@playwright\test\lib\cli.js
- <project_root>\fe\node_modules\playwright-core\lib\cli\cli.js
- <project_root>\fe\node_modules\playwright-core\cli.js
- <project_root>\fe\node_modules\@playwright\test\cli.js

   at ..\src\measurement\types.ts:1

> 1 | import { Feature, Point } from 'geojson'
    | ^

    at Object.<anonymous> (<project_root>\fe\src\measurement\types.ts:1:1)
    at Object.<anonymous> (<project_root>\fe\src\user\types.ts:3:1)

=================
 no tests found.
=================

  1 error was not a part of any test, see above for details

To open last HTML report run:

  npx playwright show-report

```
After tracing execution in he debugger it's a little clearer what happened:
1. the test file was found
2. but it could not be imported using `require` because `require` threw the above error
3. hence it was removed from the test files list
4. the runner reports 0 tests because of 2. & 3. and then prints the error
5. because there were no tests, Vite did not run

I think that could be better presented, like 
```
Running 1 tests using 1 workers
Test header.test.ts excluded because of
[stack trace here] 
```
or something like that; right now it's a bit confusing.

Now if I use ProcessMonitor (like Linux strace but for Windows) to trace filesystem activity I see that it tries to open the following files, all unsuccessfully since `geojson` is a pure type package, i.e., it exists only as `@types/geojson`; it should be looking for `@types/geojson/index.d.ts`
```
Path                                                    Result
---------------------------------------------------	--------------
<project_root>\fe\node_modules\geojson\package.json	PATH NOT FOUND
<project_root>\fe\node_modules\geojson			NAME NOT FOUND
<project_root>\fe\node_modules\geojson.js		NAME NOT FOUND
<project_root>\fe\node_modules\geojson.json		NAME NOT FOUND
<project_root>\fe\node_modules\geojson.node		NAME NOT FOUND
<project_root>\fe\node_modules\geojson.ts		NAME NOT FOUND
<project_root>\fe\node_modules\geojson.tsx		NAME NOT FOUND
<project_root>\fe\node_modules\geojson.jsx		NAME NOT FOUND
<project_root>\fe\node_modules\geojson.mjs		NAME NOT FOUND
```
Any idea what could be happening here?
comments:
### Update
I finally have a reproducible case; here it is: [pw-ct-2.zip](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/files/9803525/pw-ct-2.zip)

Run `npm run test-ct` and you will get:
```
Running 0 tests using 0 workers
Error: Cannot find module 'geojson'
Require stack:
- C:\pw-ct\fe\src\measurement\types.ts
- C:\pw-ct\fe\src\measurement\measurementsReducer.ts
- C:\pw-ct\fe\src\rootReducers.ts
- C:\pw-ct\fe\src\configureStore.ts
- C:\pw-ct\fe\playwright-ct-test\layouts\Header.test.tsx
- C:\pw-ct\fe\node_modules\@playwright\test\lib\loader.js
- C:\pw-ct\fe\node_modules\@playwright\test\lib\runner.js
- C:\pw-ct\fe\node_modules\@playwright\test\lib\cli.js
- C:\pw-ct\fe\node_modules\playwright-core\lib\cli\cli.js
- C:\pw-ct\fe\node_modules\playwright-core\cli.js
- C:\pw-ct\fe\node_modules\@playwright\test\cli.js

   at ..\src\measurement\types.ts:1

> 1 | import { Point } from 'geojson'
    | ^
  2 |
  3 | export interface Measurement {
  4 |   name?: string

    at Object.<anonymous> (C:\pw-ct\fe\src\measurement\types.ts:1:1)
    at Object.<anonymous> (C:\pw-ct\fe\src\measurement\measurementsReducer.ts:1:1)

=================
 no tests found.
=================

  1 error was not a part of any test, see above for details

To open last HTML report run:

  npx playwright show-report
```
pretty much as in the full application. The project builds and starts just fine.

Did not investigate it further but it seems you need to import `Point` as a type:

```typescript
import type { Point } from 'geojson'
```

With this change the error goes away indeed and it is not a problem to make this change also in the real application. 

Having said that, firstly Webpack does not have this issue since the application compiles, which begs the question of how many more differences there will be between Vite vs. Webpack bundling; in particular will the output really behave the same? And secondly if you go back to the project I attached to #18116, which is an earlier version of the one here, `Point` is resolved even though it is not imported as a type, so this seems rather random.
I'm facing the same issue when i setup the paths in tsconfig.json
